Question: assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuhu wa magfiratuhu...i once had a dream of darul uloom falahi daaarain from which ma teacher and dad grasduated...and i use to think about it quite often too and i also had a desire to see itt...so before i went india i had a dream of a class room in de darul uloom but was not the actual picture of the darul uloom in reality i was looking at a bunch of students and the teacher teaching and i was wearing a white kurta shalwar and shall and suddenly it started raining a lot and and i started to run in the oppossite direction of the madrasa and my dream ended..so please can u interpretate this dream jazakallahu khair Answer ID: 6391 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1580/1303=H/1429) The faiz (meant by the rain) of Falah-e-Darain is reaching to everyone whether friend and foe, an in-sha-Allah it shall continue to reach. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
